CALCULATE the probability that, for a unit-length stick broken at two independent uniformly random points (creating three pieces), the ratio of the shortest piece length L_min to the longest piece length L_max is at least 1/4.

current_plan.body:
GENERATE the joint distribution of two independent uniform break points on [0,1]
DERIVE the lengths of the three stick segments from the ordered break points
IDENTIFY the shortest segment length L_min and longest segment length L_max for each outcome
SPECIFY the condition L_min / L_max >= 1/4
DETERMINE the region in the break-point space where the condition holds
INTEGRATE the joint density over that region to obtain the probability
